mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_place ( member_id, place_type, name, address, region_code, latitude, longitude ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{placeType}, #{name}, #{address}, #{regionCode}, #{latitude}, #{longitude} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, place_type, name, address, region_code, latitude, longitude, created_at, updated_at FROM member_place WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, member_id, place_type, name, address, region_code, latitude, longitude, created_at, updated_at FROM member_place WHERE id = #{placeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_place SET place_type = #{placeType}, name = #{name}, address = #{address}, region_code = #{regionCode}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
